mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions characterized by high housing starts and strong consumer spending, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market prices in an impending slowdown, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110.0 and declines by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 110.0 and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending, as measured by retail sales, leads to higher corporate revenues and earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and the nonfarm payrolls growth rate falls below 50,000 per month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown, as indicated by declining industrial production and falling housing starts, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of manufacturing slowdown periods, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
